neighbours.label: a verb or comparative saying that something appears large or looms (would loom larger)
fire: The dark planet would loom larger in the evening sky.
Those debts began to loom larger with each passing year.
The mountain seemed to loom larger as we got closer.
Her fear of failure loomed larger after the exam.
The question will loom larger at next month's talks.
Great towers loomed larger through the morning fog.
The deadline loomed larger as the weekend went by.
That threat would loom larger in the years ahead.
quiet: The dark planet would be visible in the evening sky.
Those debts began to shrink with each passing year.
The mountain seemed to fade away as we got closer.
Her fear of failure was gone after the exam.
The question will be raised at next month's talks.
Great towers were hidden by the morning fog.
The deadline passed quietly as the weekend went by.
That threat would disappear in the years ahead.
